findings.message: User task "Review order" is a job-worker user task; Camunda 8.10 deprecates those in favour of Camunda user tasks.
findings.suggestion: Add zeebe:userTask to make it a Camunda user task.

findings.message: User task "Review order" has no zeebe:formDefinition.
findings.suggestion: Link a form (formId), an external form, or an embedded form.

findings.message: Service task "Charge payment" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
Message "PaymentConfirmed" used by Receive task "Await payment confirmation" has no zeebe:subscription.
findings.suggestion: Add a zeebe:subscription with a correlationKey to the message.

findings.message: Business rule task "Determine shipping cost" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:calledDecision or zeebe:taskDefinition.
Call activity "Create invoice" has no zeebe:calledElement processId.
findings.suggestion: Set the id of the process to call.

findings.message: Service task "Ship order" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
Timer intermediate catch event "Wait for delivery window" has timeDuration "${deliveryWindow}", which is not an ISO 8601 duration (PT15M).
findings.suggestion: Write an ISO 8601 duration (PT15M), or a FEEL expression starting with "=".

findings.message: Script task "Build summary" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:script or zeebe:taskDefinition.
Service task "Notify customer" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
Service task "Escalate review" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
